false_negatives_audit.observations: The majority of false negatives correspond to Tool Wear Failure (TWF). In TWF, degradation is probabilistic over active wear time (200-240 min) while instantaneous temperatures, torque, and speeds remain within normal operating bands.

false_positives_audit.observations: False positives are concentrated at severe mechanical stress operating boundaries (spindle torque > 50 Nm or rotational speed near stall limits). Notably, one false positive (UDI 5490) was flagged with random failure (RNF=1) in the generator despite Machine failure=0.
